Container.Name: ownCloud
Container.Overview: ownCloud provides universal access to your files via the web, your computer or your mobile devices wherever you are. MariaDB is built into the image. Existing ownCloud 10.x installations use PHP 7.4; ownCloud 11.x uses PHP 8.3. New installs use ownCloud 11.x and MariaDB 10.11.[br] Configuration: **/config** - Where ownCloud should store its config files. **/data** - Where ownCloud should store its data files.[br] **Note:** Set Network to br0 and assign a static IP address.
Container.Description: ownCloud provides universal access to your files via the web, your computer or your mobile devices — wherever you are. MariaDB is built into the image. Existing ownCloud 10.x installations use PHP 7.4; ownCloud 11.x uses PHP 8.3. New installs use ownCloud 11.x and MariaDB 10.11. Moving an existing MariaDB 10.6 database to 10.11 is an optional, deliberate upgrade.

Config.Name: Auto OS Updates
Config.Description: When set to 1, OS and Package updates will be done on every restart.

Config.Name: MariaDB Target Version
Config.Description: Leave blank for automatic selection. For a deliberate upgrade of existing MariaDB 10.6 data to 10.11, set this to 10.11 and configure the other two migration variables. New installs do not need this setting.

Config.Name: MariaDB Upgrade
Config.Description: Set to 1 only for the one-time upgrade of existing MariaDB 10.6 data to 10.11. Requires Target Version=10.11 and Backup Confirmation=YES. Reset to 0 after the upgrade.

Config.Name: MariaDB Backup Confirmation
Config.Description: Set to YES only after stopping the container and making a complete ownCloud appdata backup, including /config/database. The image requires this confirmation but cannot verify the backup. Clear after the upgrade.
